baselineFindings: tryHandleIncludedItemQuestion stripped «ese» only when followed by a space, so a bare «ese» stayed as subject, matched no product and the generic composition handler listed the sodas' (missing) ingredients and left them as a pending choice

fix: Bare demonstratives («ese/eso/esto…», «el plato/combo») are no subject, so the question falls back to the last confirmed product; the short composition shortcut skips drink objects. The combo offer keeps only combos whose name contains the full dish name when any does, lists the drink options («Incluye bebida a elegir: …») and fixes gender. tryAnswerComboSwapOffer (pre-agent, both modes) resolves a one-combo replacement offer: decline keeps the line; a combo drink option replaces the line with that drink; yes/«mejor el combo» asks the drink keeping the replacement; a sized drink matching the combo's own drink size goes into the combo; another sized menu drink without options is added apart with the brand as note and the dish stays. The glossary adds «litros» only when no unit follows. drinkInclusion is unchanged (brand options still do not prove soda); sodaBrandIn is new.
